stage.quote: AI SANDBOX ISLO: The always-on execution layer for AI coding agents · PRODUCT · RELEASED MAY 2026
stage.note: Islo is a product line launched by Incredibuild in May 2026, not a separately-funded company. Funding figures below are for parent company Incredibuild, which was itself acquired by Fortissimo Capital (a PE firm) in 2018 and later took a large growth investment from Insight Partners.

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of Incredibuild's two reported rounds: $140M (Insight Partners, 2021, primary+secondary per VentureBeat) + $35M (2022, per TechCrunch headline cited by Wikipedia). No dedicated funding has been reported for Islo itself; figure is for the whole parent company and may not reflect net new capital since the 2021 round included a secondary component.

last_round.quote: Lunden, Ingrid (2022-06-27). "Incredibuild powers up with $35M for gaming and software dev". TechCrunch. Retrieved 2022-12-22.

note: Islo (islo.dev) is an AI-agent sandbox product launched in May 2026 by Incredibuild, an Israeli grid-computing/build-acceleration company founded in 2002. Incredibuild was acquired by PE firm Fortissimo Capital in 2018, then took a $140M primary+secondary investment led by Insight Partners in March 2021, and a further $35M round in June 2022 (per TechCrunch, via Wikipedia citation; original article page no longer resolves live, so lead investor and exact round type for the 2022 raise could not be independently confirmed within the research budget). No funding, revenue, or headcount figures specific to Islo as a standalone entity have been published; it is best understood as a new product line inside an established, well-capitalized private company rather than a separately financed startup.
